name: Tantalus on Tour

start.dialog: Tantalus Theater Troupe at your service! We're putting on a show here in the Uplands, but we need a volunteer for the lead role! You look like you've got star potential! What do you say?
start.objective: Participate in the Tantalus Theater Troupe's performance

progress.dialog: Okay, your line is: 'Oh woe is me, for I am but a simple hero!' Then you strike a pose! Got it?
progress.objective: Learn your lines and perform in the play

complete.dialog: Bravo! Magnificent performance! The crowd loved you! Here - take this. It's a Tantalus membership card. Anytime you need a distraction or an escape... we can help.

party_comments.kade: Acting... not really my thing, but it was fun.
party_comments.twist: I want to be in the play too! Can I be the villain?!

hidden_outcome: If you ad-lib new lines that make the audience cheer, Zidane recruits you officially as an honorary Tantalus member with access to their hideout
